title: rosa × dumetorum var. suboxyphylla
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. suboxyphylla, commonly known as Rosa damascena var. suboxyphylla, is a variant of the Damask rose, a fragrant and ornamental plant. It is valued for its essential oil, which has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum var. suboxyphylla include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Rosa × dumetorum var. suboxyphylla, such as geraniol, linalool, and nerol, contribute to its therapeutic properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
